descriptionBodyText.simpleText:
I help people to become Pro Web Developers. Let's learn and grow together!

Hi Procodrrs, Mera naam Anurag Singh hai aur main ek self-taught software engineer hoon.
Waise dekha jaaye to koi bhi subject achcha ya bura nahi hota, fark isse padta hai ki use padhaya kaise jata hai.

Mera goal kafi simple hai. Jo bhi bachche, duniya ke kisi bhi kone se, zero se advanced level ka web development sikhna chahate hain, unko HIGH QUALITY and INDEPTH content mile. Aur sabse important baat,  web development ko ekdum FUN aur INTERESTING tarike se padhane ki zimmedari meri hai.

Mai to regular videos dalta rahunga, aap bs sath dete rahiye aur sikhte rahiye.
Agar meri video dekh kar apka koi concept clear hota hai to aap apne web developer friends ke saath us video ko share kar sakte hain.

Apne yahan tak padha uske liye bahot bahot dhanyawad. Milte hain kisi video mein tabtak ke liye,
Bye Bye...
